items.definition:
The edge of a road
We stopped at the roadside to admire the view.

A pretense or a fake
The whole trial was a complete sham.

A fault or defect
We all have our shortcomings.

A person who harasses or pursues someone obsessively
The celebrity hired security to deal with a stalker.

A person who manages property or affairs for another
The flight steward helped the passengers.

A person who removes clothes for entertainment
The performer was a stripper at the adult club.

A Jewish house of worship
They attended services at the local synagogue.

A foolish or inept person
Don't be such a wally, you can do it!

The distance between successive crests of a wave; a particular way of thinking
We're finally on the same wavelength about the project.

a place for a ship to moor; a sleeping place on a ship or train
The ship was given a berth at the busy port.

the act of demanding money or other benefit in return for not revealing compromising information
He was accused of blackmail after threatening to expose her secrets.

illegal entry into a building with intent to commit a crime, especially theft
The police are investigating a recent burglary at the museum.

a state or period of uncontrolled excitement or wild behavior
The crowd was in a frenzy after the band's performance.

the achievement of something desired, promised, or predicted; satisfaction or happiness as a result of developing one's abilities or character
She found great fulfillment in her volunteer work.

water held underground in the soil or in pores and crevices in rock
The well draws water from the groundwater supply.

the fact of insisting that something is the case or should be done
At her insistence, we stayed for dinner.

a special anniversary of an event, especially one celebrating twenty-five or fifty years
The town celebrated its golden jubilee with a grand parade.

temporary accommodation
We found lodging for the night at a small inn.

the start or beginning of something
From the outset, it was clear that the project would be challenging.

A person or thing of great energy, strength, or power
The company is a powerhouse in the tech industry.

A transparent optical element with flat, polished surfaces that refract light
A prism can split white light into a spectrum of colors.

The process of developing something again or in a new way
The city council approved the redevelopment of the old factory site.

An action that is performed as a response to a stimulus and without conscious thought
The doctor checked her knee-jerk reflex.

The action of paying back a loan or debt
The loan repayment schedule was very strict.

The mass of eggs contained in the ovaries of a female fish or shellfish
Sushi often includes salmon roe.

Waste or rough fragments of stone, brick, concrete, etc., especially as debris from the demolition of buildings
After the earthquake, the streets were filled with rubble.

A line where two pieces of fabric are sewn together
The seam on her dress was coming undone.

a large group of insects or people
A swarm of bees flew out of the hive.

a ship or vehicle for carrying liquids
The oil tanker was enormous.

a self-propelled underwater missile
The submarine launched a torpedo at the target.

a carnivorous mammal of the weasel family
The wolverine is known for its strength and ferocity.

the head of a monastery
The abbot led the monks in prayer.

the action of taking someone away illegally by force
The police are investigating the abduction of the child.

an act of assessing something or someone
She received a positive performance appraisal.

a type of poplar tree
The aspen leaves trembled in the breeze.

a person or thing that carries or holds something
The bearer of the message arrived late.

a minister, priest, or rabbi serving a special group
The hospital chaplain offered comfort to the patients.

food (informal)
Let's get some chow after the game.

an official who investigates deaths
The coroner determined the cause of death.

inability or refusal to accept that something is true or real
She stared at him in utter disbelief.

courage and determination; small loose particles of stone or sand
It takes a lot of grit to succeed in difficult circumstances.

a unit of area equal to 10,000 square meters
The farm covers an area of fifty hectares.

the state of having no home
The city is working to address the issue of homelessness.

a type of dog; to pursue relentlessly
The hunter's hound tracked the scent through the forest.

inability to do something successfully
His incompetence led to several mistakes in the project.

inability to sleep
She suffered from insomnia for weeks after the accident.

a person or group that invades a country or territory
The defenders successfully repelled the invaders.

a person who is mentally ill (dated, often offensive); a foolish or reckless person
He drove like a lunatic, swerving through traffic.

an alcoholic drink of fermented honey and water
In ancient times, mead was a popular drink.

the hard outer shell of a nut; a very small space
To put it in a nutshell, we're out of money.

the pharmaceutical industry
The pharma industry invests heavily in research.

a high degree of skill; expertise
He demonstrated great proficiency in several languages.

a person who sins
The preacher spoke about the forgiveness of a sinner.

a long step; a significant advance
She walked with a confident stride.

a chemical element (S)
Sulfur is known for its distinctive smell.

a long, narrow open receptacle for water or food for animals; a long, narrow depression
The pigs ate from the wooden trough.

the treatment and education received by a child during childhood
Her strict upbringing made her very disciplined.

a bet
He placed a small wager on the horse race.

a sharp blow or slap
He gave the ball a good whack.

a device for increasing speed; a substance that speeds up a chemical reaction
Press the accelerator to go faster.

a synthetic fiber or plastic material
She painted the canvas with acrylic paints.

the act of rising or climbing
The ascent of the mountain was challenging.

a song or poem that tells a story
The singer performed a beautiful folk ballad.

the use of living systems and organisms to develop or make products
Advances in biotechnology are transforming medicine and agriculture.
